name: floating-shapes
title: Floating Shapes
description: A few simple solids (icosahedron, torus, box, octahedron) floating and turning slowly, flat-shaded or wireframe, coloured from theme variables.

meta.when: An abstract, geometric accent for a hero or a feature section. Use it inside scene. For a single soft object use orb; to show a real object use model-stage.
meta.example:
<Scene aspect={16 / 9}>
  <FloatingShapes />
</Scene>

<Scene aspect={2}>
  <FloatingShapes
    shapes={[
      { kind: "torus", position: [-1.5, 0, 0], color: "--highlight" },
      { kind: "box", position: [1.5, 0.4, -1], size: 0.8, color: "--foreground", wireframe: true },
    ]}
  />
</Scene>
